items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: That's where we, uh, me and Kid Rene was playing it. We played there. I played there with Rene at the Pelican.

ctx.x: It wasn't behind the stairs, up on the balcony, wasn't up there?

No, no. Oh, that was the Pelican, like, was on Rampard and Gravia. That was, that had a stairs that go up. Balcony in front. Yeah. That's where we, uh, me and Kid Rene was playing it. We played there. I played there with Rene at the Pelican. On Rampard between, uh, Neb Gravia. Yes, I know by Neb Gravia. Well, we had, well, Beansy was running that place. But they had a front porch down on the gallery, you see? And we used to go out and play a couple of numbers out on that front gallery before we'd go in and play,…
Yeah. Well, I was gonna ask again, that Oliver band with Joe Oliver, who else was in that? Can you remember, who else played with him in those days when you were working with him?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: I played with Rene... I played, I was in the band when Morris French was playing Trombone with him... René got his trumpet, uh, mashed, and my bassist got all grinded up

ctx.x: I wonder about that. What bands did you play with when you'd be advertising?

Well, it's like I said, I played, when I was playing, I was, when I played with Rene, that's practically most every, every dance he played for outside, dances he had to advertise. People hire, when they hire a band, they hire for the advertising, too, you see. They give you two dollars extra for that advertising. Did Rene ever buck against Louis Armstrong? Oh, Armstrong, practically yes. Well, Armstrong, he didn't, he didn't, didn't much, he didn't do much advertising. Uh-huh. You know, because when Armstrong…
I'll ask a couple questions, see like where you were born right here in New Orleans.

I started the playing in 1904 at Hugh Cloth's Dance Hall with O'Neill Lavish's Band, Franklin Y. Iberville. 1905 at Tom Anderson with Moran's Band, Basin and Iberville. 1907 at Harry Parker's Dance Hall, Dawson and Minetta's Band, Franklin between Iberville and Benwood. 1910 at Biller Phillips Dance Hall, Cornelius Jackson's Band, Franklin near Iberville. 1912 Liberty near Iberville, Huntson Nagel's Dance Hall with Joe Oliver's Band. 1915 with Chris Kelly's Band. 1918 Kid René's Band. 1921 Pippa Light Charles Band.
